findings.detail: `src/components/FormIssuesSummary.tsx` imports `purgeFormIssues` from `src/lib/formAnalytics.ts`, but the callee inode exports only ['FormIssue', 'countFormIssues', 'summarizeFormIssues']. Interface drift across the `src/components` → `src/lib` boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Import an exported symbol from `src/lib/formAnalytics.ts` or add `purgeFormIssues` to its exports.
findings.title: Cross-boundary import of unknown symbol `purgeFormIssues`

findings.detail: Added call `const empty = summarizeFormIssues()` passes 0 argument(s); `src/lib/formAnalytics.ts` declares `summarizeFormIssues(errors: ContactFormErrors): FormIssue[]` (1 required / 1 total).
findings.suggested_fix: Align the call with the declared signature in `src/lib/formAnalytics.ts`.
findings.title: Cross-boundary call arity mismatch: `summarizeFormIssues`

findings.detail: Added call `const recheck = summarizeFormIssues(errors)` invokes `summarizeFormIssues` (declared O(N) in `src/lib/formAnalytics.ts`) inside a loop, giving effective O(N×N) — e.g. O(N) callee ⇒ O(N^2) total.
findings.suggested_fix: Hoist the call out of the loop, batch the input, or renegotiate the callee's declared complexity.
findings.title: Complexity amplification across boundary: `summarizeFormIssues` declared O(N)

notes: boundary check: 1 changed file(s) checked against inode store
